system.story: Study and tag one enemy; the study-and-tag her whole trade turns on.

effect.after:
Choose one enemy in line of sight. You gain an edge on Power Rolls against that target and treat yourself as knowing its weaknesses. One Marked target at a time (raised at higher tiers). Lasts until the target drops, you re-Mark, or the encounter ends.

Enhance - spend 1 Advantage: also reveal a defensive weakness allies can exploit against the same target.

Hunter (Quarry): your Mark also tracks - you always know a Marked target's direction and distance.
